description: Matrix2: add, sub, scale, mul, mul_vec, tr_mul, transpose, trace, determinant, try_inverse (regular, singular, near-singular), outer

format.tolerance_unit: raw units (1 ulp = 2^-32), applies to every output scalar

ops.name: matrix2_scale
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: matrix2_mul
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: matrix2_mul_vec
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: matrix2_tr_mul
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: matrix2_outer
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: matrix2_try_inverse
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: matrix2_try_inverse_singular
ops.doc: a.try_inverse().is_some() on exactly singular integer-valued matrices

ops.name: matrix2_try_inverse_near_singular
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: matrix2_determinant
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit
